desc: Establish a correct colored-batch formulation: for a fixed ordered batch assignment, characterize its minimum adjacent-swap cost as occurrence-pair inversions.
Refute noncrossing interval and one-batch-per-value canonical structures using exhaustive counterexamples.
Validate the proposed leftmost-greedy run-reduction algorithm against the public samples.
Derive a rigorous proof of the local-reduction characterization and leftmost-greedy optimality.
Independently exhaustively validate against BFS for small arrays and verify linked-list candidate update coverage.
Establish the algorithm's time complexity, check edge cases, and produce the final Python solution.
